column1: # tests/ports.tsv - manifest of every language port.
#   3. build      compile / syntax-check command; empty = run directly.
#   4. run        command to run the port. Placeholders: %SRC%, %BIN%, %DIR%.
#   5. crash sed  sed expression replacing the '# CRASH-INJECT-POINT'
#                 marker line in the tick loop with code that aborts the
#                 program unexpectedly; empty = crash test not applicable.
#   6. crash rc   expected exit code of the crashed variant (default 42)
#   7. flags      comma-separated: skip-pty (pty tests not supported)

OBS.cs|C#|mkdir -p %BIN% && printf '%s' '<Project Sdk="Microsoft.NET.Sdk"><PropertyGroup><OutputType>Exe</OutputType><TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework><AssemblyName>OBS.cs</AssemblyName><Nullable>disable</Nullable><ImplicitUsings>disable</ImplicitUsings><EnableDefaultCompileItems>false</EnableDefaultCompileItems><InvariantGlobalization>true</InvariantGlobalization></PropertyGroup><ItemGroup><Compile Include="%SRC%" /></ItemGroup></Project>' > %DIR%/OBS.cs.csproj && dotnet build %DIR%/OBS.cs.csproj -c Release -o %BIN% --nologo -v q|%BIN%/OBS.cs|s,// CRASH-INJECT-POINT,CrashExit(42);,|42|
